about: CBZ Properties manages and develops the Group's real estate interests for individuals, SMEs, corporates and institutions: development and project management, residential and commercial sales, leasing and property management, valuations and advisory, estate agency and facilities management. A purchase can be financed by a CBZ Bank mortgage and insured by CBZ Insurance.
